---
title: "Hypothesis-test example"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
# remotes::install_github("scienceverse/scienceverse")
library(scienceverse)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(marginaleffects)
```

```{r}
study <- study(
  name = "Example",
  abstract = "Example used in Improving the Transparency of Power Analyses through Standardised Reporting"
  )
```

```{r}
study <- add_hypothesis(
  study, 
  id = "H1",
  description = "The intervention will be superior to the control condition on a primary outcome"
  )
```

```{r}
study <- add_analysis(
  study, 
  id = "A1",
  code = lm(y ~ group + pre, data) |> hypotheses("groupint <= 0"), 
  software = R.version.string,
  description = "ANCOVA with post-intervention outcome (y) as the dependent variable, baseline measurement (pre) as a covariate, and group as a predictor. The posthoc comparison tests whether the, adjusted group difference is greater than zero."
         ) 
```

```{r}
study <- add_criterion(
  study,
  id = "C1",
  result = "p.value[1]",
  operator = "<",
  comparator = 0.05,
  analysis_id = "A1",
  hypothesis_id = "H1"
  )
```

```{r}
study <- add_eval(
  study, 
  "corroboration",
  evaluation = "C1",
  description = "The hypothesis is corroborated if the p-value from the one-sided test is smaller than 0.05"
  )
```

```{r}
study <- add_data(
  study, 
  id = "data", 
  data = "simulated_data_analysis.csv"
  )
```

```{r}
study_analyse(study)
```

```{r}
study_save(study, "hypothesis-test.json", "json")
```
